prompt: How much is a full detail in Snohomish WA?
answer:
Gemini said

In Snohomish, Washington, a full auto detail (inside and out) typically ranges from $300 to $450, depending on the size of your vehicle and its current condition.

Local professional detailers (many of which operate as mobile services that come directly to your home or office) generally structure their pricing by vehicle size:   
The Reflection Detail

Coupes / Compact Cars: $300 – $369   
mikeysdetailing.com

Sedans / 2-Row SUVs: $375 – $409   
thereflectiondetail.com

3-Row SUVs / Trucks / Vans: $425 – $449   
thereflectiondetail.com

What a Full Detail Usually Includes:

Interior: Thorough vacuuming, crevice blowout, steam cleaning of seats and carpets, dashboard/console conditioning, and interior glass cleaning.

Exterior: Hand wash and dry, wheel and tire deep clean, paint decontamination, and a protective sealant or ceramic wax.   
mikeysdetailing.com

Potential Extra Costs:

Pet hair removal, excessive dirt/mud, or heavy staining: Can add anywhere from $30 to over $100 depending on how much extra labor is required.   
Mobile Car Detailing Snohomish, WA

Add-on services: Extra treatments like engine bay cleaning, paint correction, or headlight restoration will cost more if not bundled into a promotional package.
